items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Debuts AI Teammate For Wealth Advisors
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) introduced an AI-powered chat assistant called "AI Teammate" within its wealth and investment management unit. The AI Teammate tool is designed to support financial advisors with client queries, planning tasks, and day to day workflow. Wells Fargo reports that AI Teammate is intended to respond to changing client expectations for more modern, tech driven advisory support.
